ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify if INVALID should consume all gas or just the gas used up to that point.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume INVALID consumes all remaining gas, consistent with other exception-throwing behavior in the EVM.

ambiguities.text: The term 'designated invalid instruction' does not specify behavior in nested call contexts (CALL, DELEGATECALL).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume INVALID in a nested context only reverts that call frame, returning failure to the parent context.

implicit_assumptions.description: Opcode 0xfe will remain reserved for INVALID and not be repurposed in future EVM versions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Existing contracts using 0xfe for explicit abort could behave unexpectedly.

implicit_assumptions.description: Compilers and tooling will correctly use 0xfe to represent intentional abort paths.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Accidental execution of INVALID could cause unexpected transaction failures.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot inject 0xfe into contract bytecode after deployment.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contract functionality could be disabled by injecting INVALID opcodes.
